title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-09-16) — it closes twelve days before the September 2027 Consumer Confidence print, not during it
source: EST: derived this session from the Board's own stated blackout rule applied to a meeting date this session re-read directly. THE RULE is quoted as INHERITED from three sibling ledgers that extracted it from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf (fomc-2027-03-17, fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16 and fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29 all carry it verbatim, and this session did not re-download or re-inflate that PDF): "The blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday." THE MEETING DATE is this session's own primary: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 166,936 bytes), 2027 panel "September 14-15*". Sep 14 2027 is a Tuesday and Sep 15 a Wednesday, so the source's own worked example gives Saturday 2027-09-04 through Thursday 2027-09-16 with no inference of ours. CORROBORATED WITHOUT RE-DOING THE WORK: the fomc-blackout-start-2027-04-17 lane decoded the same PDF's shaded cells and recorded the 2027 windows as "Jan 16-28, Mar 6-18, Apr 17-29, May 29 -> Jun 10, Jul 17-29, SEP 4-16, Oct 16-28, Nov 27 -> Dec 9" -- its Sep 4-16 matches this derivation to the day, and the same ten-days-earlier arithmetic reproduces all six other 2027 windows that lane decoded. Filed estimate because it is a firm rule and an inherited decode applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date: fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is "tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-07-27/28 meeting ratifying September 14-15, not a better fetch. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), and proposed because it is the anchor for a CORRECTION that ledger had to make to its own parent. The proposal that filed consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 cautioned that "the September print sits INSIDE the 2027 FOMC blackout (Sep 4-16 ...)". It does not, and the arithmetic is not close: the window closes at the end of 2027-09-16 and the print is 2027-09-28, twelve days later. What is true, and is the more interesting fact the wrong caution was reaching for, is that the blackout sits INSIDE THE PRINT'S SURVEY PANEL rather than over its release -- the panel runs about 09-05 to 09-21 under the field window the editions' own stated cut-offs imply, so roughly its first eleven days are Fed-silent and its last six are not. THREE NOTES. (1) This is the third of eight 2027 blackout windows this calendar now tracks and the only one whose relationship to a CB print is a panel overlap rather than a release collision. (2) The window moves with its meeting: if the Committee shifts September 14-15, this date shifts with it and the CB panel's silent/loud split changes length. (3) The CB lane MEASURED whether a panel hearing a decision matters and found nothing -- 16 heard vs 35 deaf clean CB days, 0 of 9 across nine instruments, smallest p AAPL 0.0604 -- so this proposal is filed as structure worth tracking, not as an effect worth pricing. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
